A '''Blasted Asteroid''' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Blasted Asteroid]] franchise was built in the town of [[Glare Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]]. It was destroyed when a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] crashed into it.
